hero.subtitle1: Umshini wokuqala we-AI owakhelwe isimo seZimbabwe ngqo.
hero.subtitle2: Ngokungafaniyo le-AI ejwayelekileyo, u-Onesa uyazwisisa ukuphila lebhizinisi eZimbabwe.
hero.subtitle3: Hlola ingozi njalo usungule amacebo ebhizinisi angaphumelela emakethe yasekhaya.

tech.onesa_desc1: U-Onesa AI ngumshini wethu owenzelwe ukukhanyisa indlela yokuhlala, ukutshala imali, lokuphumelela eZimbabwe. Lanxa eminye imishini ye-AI isilela kulwazi lwasikhaya, u-Onesa wakhiwe kusukela phansi ukuzwisisa isimo seZimbabwe ukwedlula noma yiwuphi omunye umshini.
tech.onesa_desc2: Kusukela ekulandeleni imithetho yelizwe kuye ekucabangeni amacebo amabhizinisi axazulula izinkinga zeZimbabwe, u-Onesa ukunika ulwazi oludingayo ukuze uphumelele.
tech.onesa_local_edge_desc: Imishini ejwayelekileyo ijwayele ukugxila eNtshonalanga, iphumelela emithonjeni yomnotho ehlelekileyo kodwa yehluleka ukuzwisisa ezomnotho ze-"kukiya-kiya" (hustle) eMbare Musika kumbe ukujula kolimi lwesiShona oluhlangene leNdebele yasemaphandleni.
tech.diaspora_unlocked_desc: Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu ukwenza ezokuvakasha, ezohwebo, lokutshala imali kube lula. Ingosi yethu igcwalisa isikhala esiphakathi kwama-diaspora lamathuba asekhaya.
tech.ai_demo_question: Yimaphi amathuba okutshala imali angasuthisa enhlanyelweni eZimbabwe manje?
tech.ai_demo_response: Ingxenye ye-agriculture eZimbabwe ikhula kakhulu ekuthumeleni imikhiqizo ye-horticulture phandle. Ukutshala imali kwezokuthutha imikhiqizo eqandisiweyo (cold-chain) njengama-blueberries kusuka e-Eastern Highlands kulenzuzo enkulu...
tech.features_subtitle: Amathuluzi akhethekileyo enzelwe ukuxhumanisa ama-diaspora lamathuba asekhaya.
tech.cta_desc: Hlanganyela ohlelweni lwethu lwe-beta ube ngomunye wabokuqala ukusebenzisa ulwazi luka-Onesa AI.
tech.sectors_subtitle: U-Onesa AI unikela ulwazi olukhethekileyo ukuthuthukisa izingxenye zomnotho zeZimbabwe eziqakathekileyo.

mining.d1: Intengo yezimbiwa lesimo semakethe sikhathi sonke

hero.desc1: Landela imithetho lezitifiketi ze-EU kalula ukuze uthumele imikhiqizo yakho yeZimbabwe.
hero.desc2: Ulwazi olukhethekileyo labahlanganyeli be-German market, okuyisango elikhulu lokuya e-Europe.
hero.desc3: Zuza ezivumelwaneni ze-Economic Partnership Agreements ukuze ungene ngaphandle kokubhadala umthelo.
hero.desc4: Xhumana lenethiwekhi yabathengi labahambisi bempahla emhlabeni jikelele.
hero.desc5: Usekelo olukhethekileyo lwezitshalo ezitsha, amaluva, lemikhiqizo ye-organic.
hero.desc6: Inkomba yempahla eyenziwe ezimbonini, izigqoko, lokudla okulungisiweyo.

export.objective_subtitle: Ukuhlanganisa imikhiqizo, abahlanganyeli, lolwazi lwemakethe ukuze abathumeli baphumelele e-EU.
export.contact_form_subtitle: Gcwalisa ifomu elingezansi ukuze ukhulume labochwepheshe bethu bokuthumela phandle.
export.market_requirements_subtitle: Zwisisa imithetho ethile, izitifiketi, lamazinga okuthumela impahla eGermany.

requirements: Izidingo zokubhalwa kumaphakethe (izithako, izinto ezingabangela ukugula, indawo esuka kuyo)
Izitifiketi zokuthola impahla ngendlela efaneleyo lokusimama
I-CE Marking (uma ifaneleka, isib. izinto zokudlala)

export.product_intelligence_subtitle: Hlala uphambili ngedatha ekhombisa isidingo semikhiqizo, intengo, lokuthandwa ngabathengi.

requirements: Ukufakwa emaphaketheni kumele kuhambelane lamazinga we-EU.
Ukuqiniseka ukuthi impahla ihlala iqandisiwe kuze kuyofika.
Ukuhambisana le-EU Honey Directive (ubunjalo, isuka kuphi).
Isitifiketi se-organic sinika intengo engcono kakhulu.
Isitifiketi se-COSMOS kumbe i-NaTrue sezinto zokuzicwalisa.
Amakhasi akhombisa ukuthi kutholakala ngendlela engayibulali imvelo.
Ukubhala amabizo ezitshalo lendawo okusuka kuyo kucace.

export.partner_network_subtitle: Xhumana labathengisi beGermany abathembekileyo, abahambisi bempahla, labezokuthutha.

hero.subtitle1: Kusukela eVictoria Falls kuye eGreat Zimbabwe, uzizwele inhliziyo ye-Africa.
hero.subtitle2: Khangela imivubukulo yasendulo lamasiko esikhathi samanje aphilayo.
hero.subtitle3: Ukuhlangana lezinyamazana okungasoze kwalityalwa emapaki esizwe.
hero.subtitle4: Izakhiwo zamatshe zasendulo ezikhombisa impucuko ye-Africa.

vicfalls.name: Victoria Falls
vicfalls.desc: Enye yezimangaliso eziyisikhombisa zemvelo emhlabeni, impophoma enkulu kakhulu.
vicfalls.summary: Yaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi yiMosi-oa-Tunya (Intuthu Iduma), iVictoria Falls iphakeme ngokuphindwe kabili kuneNiagara Falls. Ungenza i-white-water rafting, bungee jumping, lemizila ye-helicopter.

greatzim.name: Great Zimbabwe
greatzim.desc: Izakhiwo zamatshe zasendulo ezikhombisa ubuciko bokwakha base-Africa.
greatzim.summary: Yakhwa phakathi kwekhulu le-11 le-15, iGreat Zimbabwe yayiyinhloko-dolobha yoMbuso weZimbabwe. Amatshe la abekwa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa udaka (mortar).

kariba.name: Kariba Dam
kariba.desc: Elinye lamachibi amakhulu akhiwe ngabantu emhlabeni, lilungele ukuhamba ngezikepe lokudoba.
kariba.summary: Ichibi leKariba lingamakhilomitha angu-5,500 square. Laziwa kakhulu ngokudoba i-tiger fish, amaholide asezikepe (houseboats), lokubuka amavukuvuku lezindlovu ogwini.

rocks.name: Balancing Rocks
rocks.desc: Amatshe amise okungaqondakaliyo ayisibonakaliso samagugu emvelo eZimbabwe.
rocks.summary: Lawa amatshe e-granite amise okungathi azawa kodwa amile njalo. Atholakala kakhulu emalini yeZimbabwe laseMatobo National Park.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Ngaphandle kwezindawo ezaziwayo, iZimbabwe ilolunye ubuhle obuningi.

hwange.name: Hwange National Park
hwange.desc: Iphaki enkulu yeZimbabwe, yaziwa ngezinkulungwane zezindlovu lezinyamazana ezinengi.
hwange.summary: I-Hwange ilezinhlobo zezinyamazana ezedlula ikhulu (100) lezinhlobo zezinyoni ezingamakhulu amane (400).

matobo.name: Matobo National Park
matobo.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO eyaziwa ngamatshe ayo (balancing rocks) lomlando wezomoya.
matobo.summary: Amagquma aseMatobo alemidwebo yase-San yasendulo njalo kulapho okungatshwa khona u-Cecil John Rhodes e-'World's View'.

eastern_highlands.name: Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.desc: Indawo elamagquma lezihlahla eziluhlaza, izimpophoma, lenkungu.
eastern_highlands.summary: Kuhlanganisa izintaba zeNyanga, Vumba, leChimanimani. Kulendawo ephakeme kakhulu eZimbabwe, iMount Nyangani.

mana_pools.name: Mana Pools National Park
mana_pools.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO ekude eyaziwa kakhulu ngemifula lohambo lokuhamba ngezinyawo phakathi kwezinyamazana.
mana_pools.summary: Isendaweni ye-Zambezi Valley, i-Mana Pools yaziwa ngobuhle bayo lokubuka izindlovu lezilwane (wild dogs) eduze.

onesa.name: Onesa AI
onesa.title: Umkhokheli wakho wasekhaya ephoketheni lakho
onesa.subtitle: Ukuhamba eZimbabwe kungaba lukhuni. U-Onesa AI uyazwisisa umnotho we-'kukiya-kiya' lemikhuba yasendaweni ukuze uhambo lwakho luhambe kahle.
onesa.companion_title: Kusukela ekubhadaleni indiza, isimo sezulu kumbe ukuthola izindawo eziphambili, u-Onesa AI ukusizile
onesa.companion_subtitle: U-Onesa AI ukusiza ukuhlela uhambo lwakho lokuzwisisa imikhuba yasendaweni. U-Onesa ungumngane opheleleyo wohambo.
onesa.prompt_question: "Onesa, yikuphi lapho okutholakala khona isadza lesintu esimnandi eHarare lanhlanje?"
onesa.prompt_response: Ukuze uthole isadza lesintu langempela eHarare, yana eMbare Musika. Abathengisi bakhona baphakela isadza elitshisayo elilokushesha okuhlukahlukeneyo. Cela 'Sadza ne Nyama' ukuze usuthe!
